lines.text: Peter urges the beloved foreigners and exiles to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which war against their soul.
Believers are to submit to every human institution for the Lord's sake, including the king and the governors he sends.
Peter tells believers to live as servants of God, love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, and honor the priests.
Christ left an example, and when people heaped abuse on Him, He entrusted Himself to Him who judges quickly.
Jesus bore our sins in His body on the tree, and believers have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of their souls.
